# Security

Uni Companion runs on your own computer and sends nothing anywhere unless you ask it to. If you find a security problem, please report it privately rather than in a public issue.

- Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** button on the repository's Security tab, or
- email hassanazawi50@gmail.com with the steps to reproduce.

You will get a reply as soon as possible. Please give a reasonable time to fix the problem before sharing details publicly.

Only the latest release is supported with security fixes.
